title: Named root not re-sighted after a commit in it: no source sighting for ~10 h despite host-delivered turns, so evaluations stay stale at unconfirmed_declaration
outcome: After a new commit in a named root, the host's next host-delivered turn of the naming session records a source sighting of that root at its current HEAD and tree, so an independent evaluation that declares that revision is not marked stale with unconfirmed_declaration.
acceptance: Root cause identified with file:line: why no sighting was recorded for root .worktrees\remote-verification-carry-11859 (generation 3616, binding fe227bcb, session-11859, Engram project) after 07:02:27Z, although HEAD moved from 9b9a2564 to 75af1b27 at about 09:12Z and many host-delivered turns followed.

A behavioural test reproduces it: a named root whose HEAD moves after naming, followed by a host-delivered turn of the naming session, records a sighting at the new HEAD and tree. The test fails before the fix and passes after.

The supported recovery, if any is needed for a root already in this state, is documented in docs/ next to the evaluation-sighting text, and needs no new naming generation unless that is the designed path. The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
